documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Xtranet Technologies Limited reported strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust execution and growth across its integrated business verticals. Management highlighted an expanding order book of approximately Rs. 390 crores and a healthy bid pipeline exceeding Rs. 2,000 crores. The company is strategically diversifying away from government concentration toward enterprise and BFSI clients while establishing a dedicated data center subsidiary.

guidance.claim: The management's ambition is to surpass its original revenue guidance while sustaining strong EBITDA and PAT margins.
guidance.quote: The momentum achieved during H1 gives us confidence in our full-year performance, and our ambition is to surpass our original revenue guidance while sustaining strong EBITDA and PAT margins.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting revenue of over Rs. 500 crores for FY27, representing a growth of approximately 35% to 40%.
guidance.quote: Yes, so here targeting the FY26, we closed at Rs. 365 crore and we are targeting 500 plus crores for FY27. Approximately 35 to 40% of the growth.

demand_outlook.claim: India's installed data center capacity is expected to increase nearly fivefold to approximately 7.5 gigawatts by March 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: India's installed data center capacity is expected to increase nearly fivefold to approximately 7.5 gigawatts by March 2030, supported by the investment of more than INR 3 lakh crores over the next four, five financial years.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth for Indian IT service companies is projected at 3% to 5% in FY’27.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue growth for Indian IT service companies is projected at 3% to 5% in FY’27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growth in Data Centre Infrastructure and IT Operations is driven by new mandates and expanding managed services within existing accounts.
demand_outlook.quote: Growth is driven by new data centre mandates and expanding managed services within existing accounts.

demand_outlook.claim: IT spending in India is expected to continue growing at a healthy double-digit rate.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, IT spending in India is expected to continue growing at a healthy double-digit rate, with increasing investment across infrastructure, software, and IT services.

demand_outlook.claim: The data center market in India is projected to reach over USD 13 billion by 2034, growing at a CAGR of 10% plus.
demand_outlook.quote: Within this, the data center market, which was around USD 5.5 billion in 2025, projected to reach at USD 13 plus billion by 2034, growing at a CAGR of 10% plus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company formed a dedicated subsidiary focused on developing and operating data center infrastructure.
capex_expansion.quote: An important strategic development during the quarter was the formation of Xtranet Data Center, a dedicated subsidiary focused on developing and operating data center infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Initially, the company is planning to start a 2MW data center with an expansion capacity of around 10MW.
capex_expansion.quote: We have created a subsidiary because it is an asset-intensive business and initially we are planning to start with the 2MW with the expansion capacity of around 10MW.

capex_expansion.claim: Putting up the initial 2MW data center will require roughly around Rs. 130 crores to Rs. 140 crores of investment.
capex_expansion.quote: Chetan Anand: Sir, initially we are looking for putting up a 2MW data center which will be needing roughly around Rs. 130 crores, Rs. 140 crores of investment which will come partly from our internal accruals and partly from the money which will be raised through debt also.

capex_expansion.claim: The formation of Xtranet Data Centre as a dedicated subsidiary marks a strategic step towards developing and operating owned data centre infrastructure.
capex_expansion.quote: Formation of Xtranet Data Centre, a dedicated subsidiary, marks a strategic step towards developing and operating owned data centre infrastructure, positioning it as a key growth engine over the medium to long term.

margins_costs.claim: During Q2 FY’27, consolidated revenue increased by 63% year-on-year to approximately Rs. 110 crores, while operational EBITDA grew by 144% to approximately Rs. 22 crores, with margins improving to 20.42%.
margins_costs.quote: During Q2 FY’27, our consolidated revenue increased by 63% year-on-year to approximately Rs. 110 crores, while operational EBITDA grew by 144% to approximately Rs. 22 crores, with margins improving to 20.42%.

margins_costs.claim: For H1 FY’27, revenue grew by 42% to approximately Rs. 160 crores and operational EBITDA increased by 123% to approximately Rs. 33 crores.
margins_costs.quote: For H1 FY’27, revenue grew by 42% to approximately Rs. 160 crores. Operational EBITDA increased by 123% to approximately Rs. 33 crores, with EBITDA margins improving by 749 basis points to 20.49%.

margins_costs.claim: Operational EBITDA margins reached 20.42% in Q2 FY27, improving by 677 basis points year-on-year.
Consolidated revenue from operations increased by 11% year-on-year to approximately 51 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated revenue from operations increased by 11% year-on-year to approximately 51 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Operational EBITDA increased by 89% Y-o-Y to approximately INR 10 crores, with EBITDA expanding by 855 basis points to 20.59%.
margins_costs.quote: More significantly, operational EBITDA increased by 89% Y-o-Y to approximately INR 10 crores, with EBITDA expanding by 855 basis points to 20.59%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at approximately INR 6 crores, representing a 77% Y-o-Y increase, while PAT margin improved by 444 basis points to 11.88%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at approximately INR 6 crores, representing a 77% Y-o-Y increase, while PAT margin improved by 444 basis points to 11.88%.

orders_capacity.claim: During Q2 FY’27, the company secured fresh orders of approximately Rs. 90 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: During Q2 FY’27, we secured fresh order of approximately Rs. 90 crores, taking our order book to around Rs. 390 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The bid pipeline remained strong at over Rs. 2,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our bid pipeline also remained strong at over Rs. 2,000 crores, providing opportunities to further expand our business.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's outstanding order book stood at INR 3,900 million as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Outstanding order book of INR 3,900 Mn (as of September 30, 2026) across multiple states and clients provides revenue visibility and execution continuity over themediumterm.

orders_capacity.claim: Xtranet secured fresh orders worth approximately INR 850 to 900 million during Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Secured fresh orders worth approximately INR 850–900 Mn during Q2 FY27, taking the total order book to around INR 3,900 Mn, supported by new business wins in BFSI and extensions of existing customer engagements, strengthening client relationships and revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an active bid pipeline of over INR 22,000 million spanning data centres and other technology-led opportunities.
orders_capacity.quote: Active bid pipeline of over INR 22,000 Mn, spanning Data Centres, Enterprise Applications, Digital Services and other technology-led opportunities, provides significant potential for future order inflows.

orders_capacity.claim: Fresh orders worth approximately Rs. 60 crores were secured during the quarter, taking the order book to around INR 373 crores as of June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to see healthy momentum in order inflows during the quarter, securing fresh orders worth approximately Rs. 60 crores. This took our order book to around INR 373 crores as of June 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The active bid pipeline stood at approximately Rs. 1200 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: In addition, our active bid pipeline stood at approximately Rs. 1200 crores spanning data center infrastructure, enterprise applications, digital services, and proprietary platforms.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 55% of the order book is expected to be executable during FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Importantly, approximately 55% of this order book is expected to be executable during FY27, giving us a meaningful base of revenue visibility for the current financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The government business contribution has now reduced to approximately 30% to 35%, marking a structural shift toward private enterprises and BFSI institutions.
capital_allocation.quote: However, with increasing traction from private enterprises, BFSI institutions, and other corporate customers, our government business contribution has now reduced to approximately 30% to 35%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Securing timely availability of hardware and software and protecting margins against supply disruption temporarily increased working capital requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: While this has temporarily increased our working capital requirements, we believe these investments will support stronger execution, revenue growth, and profitability during H2 FY’27.

risks_headwinds.claim: The cost of hardware has moved almost 3x to 4x in size over the last year.
risks_headwinds.quote: The cost of hardware has moved almost 3x-4x size basically.

risks_headwinds.claim: Procuring products has become a little bit of a challenge besides high prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: But till now, on our company side, we have not faced any kind of a cancellation or anything. We are very strategically working on wherein we can fulfil the requirement of the customer end-to-end and we are trying to cope up as of now.

management_commitments.claim: The revenue contribution from international proposals will start from the fourth quarter of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Sukhbir Singh Kukreja: The revenue contribution will start hopefully from the Q4 of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: International expansion remains a strategic priority for exploring overseas business opportunities and technology partnerships.
management_commitments.quote: International expansion remains a strategic priority, with the company exploring overseas business opportunities, technology partnerships and collaborations to diversify its geographical revenue base.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to keep the data center portion at 50% of overall revenue and target 35% to 40% annual growth in this segment.
management_commitments.quote: So, data center portion, we want to keep it at 50% of the overall revenue and year on year, we are expanding. We are looking forward to 35% to 40% of the annual growth in this segment from our business perspective.

management_commitments.claim: The steady tax rate will be close to 25% for the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: It will be close to 25 odd percent. That tax rate will be considered for the next two years, ma'am.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to grow around 35% to 40% CAGR in the next three years' time.
management_commitments.quote: Overall goal is basically we want to grow around 35% to 40% CAGR in the next three years' time.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
